title: A Hidden Grotto: res/field/grottoes/<grotto>.json
description: What a Hidden Grotto can hold (archive a/2/7/3, HollowFile in src/ov036/scrcmd_hidden_hollow.c), which s0294_HiddenHollowGetParam reads. Every day generateHollow rolls the grotto's slot, 0 to 10 (or none), and a group, 0 to 3: slots 0 to 2 are the Pokémon of white2 or black2 (each version reads its own), 3 to 6 the items, 7 to 10 the hidden items, and the group picks one of the four entries of the slot. tools/data/grotto_data.py packs the grottoes in the order of their entrances in src/ov012/hidden_hollow.c (its GROTTOES). A string value is the name of a constant from generated/ or include/constants/.

white2.description: The Pokémon of slots 0 to 2 in White 2

black2.description: The Pokémon of slots 0 to 2 in Black 2

items.description: The items of slots 3 to 6, which lie in the grotto as an item ball

hidden_items.description: The items of slots 7 to 10, hidden in the grotto

unk18.description: Two bytes that no code reads, 0 in every grotto

max_level.description: The level is min_level plus a random number below max_level - min_level, so max_level itself is never rolled

female_below.description: The grotto's gender roll is 0 to 99, and the Pokémon is female when the roll is below this: 0 is always male, 100 always female
